notes.title: Robber's shack update
notes.content:
Hello! Robber's shack was updated. You may notice script in robber's shack level was a little bit rough. I am happy to announce that I spent quite a some time improving it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135751/2a8504e4fad4c24b83f7ddcf5ba9e6bb4b56742b.png

There were many minor bugs: camera movement wasn't smooth enough, positioning was a little bit inaccurate, animations require some improvement. But one bug was special, I called it Angry Ghost. In very rare situation robber kid could dissapear, and the game keep going like nothing happend. I think this is just hilarious.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135751/9e25dde098966884a92577377285f7265fe7c51d.png

Anyways, the script is already fixed, the robber's shack looks much better now.

notes.title: Help translate Midnight Quest into your language!
notes.content:
Do you know great feeling whan you see that game you like is translated to your native language?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135751/581b05a78d34667cb21497d220d67d7ae30c2d88.png

I'd love to make Midnight Quest as accessible to as wide an audience as possible, so I am looking for help translating the game into other languages! I am trying to use as little text as possible in the game, it's only 225 words in English - easy!


If you'd like to help, simply grab  this file, and open it in your favourite text editor. You should see lines like this:

[code]14: New game
15: Settings
16: Credits[/code]

You can see line number and English text in the line, simply replace English phrases with phrases in your language. 

Once you're done, email the file to me at sergeyromanko@gmail.com.

Check below if your language is already translated! Don't see your language: then get in touch and I can almost certainly add it!

Translation Status :

Russian: ✓ completed
Spanish: ✓ completed
French: ✓ completed
Italian: ✓ completed
German: ✓ completed
Swedish: not done
Polish: not done 
Portuguese: not done 
Brazil Portuguese: ✓ completed
Chinese Traditional: not done
Chinese Simplified: ✓ completed
Japanese: not done
Korean: not done
Norwegian: ✓ completed
Dutch: ✓ completed
Ukrainian: ✓ completed
Polish: ✓ completed


If you start a translation, please post here so I can update the list.
Your help is extremely important for me and other players!
